data.title: Next queue number
story: Every customer gets the next queue number.
The ticket machine only fits 3 digits: after 999 the number goes back to 1. At the start of the day (last number 0) it starts from 1.

explanation: Usually the number goes up by one, but after 999 it must go back to 1. Edge cases like this are often missed.
hints: Return last + 1 for the normal case.
Add an if: when last is already 999, return 1.
